question: Simone Biles, the winner of the 2025 Laureus World Sportswoman of the Year award, is associated with the sport of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**gymnastics**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Simone Biles**, a world-renowned athlete, is associated with the sport of **gymnastics**. She is considered one of the greatest gymnasts of all time due to her extraordinary performance in international competitions.
 
• She has won multiple **Olympic gold medals**, including her stellar performance at the **2016 Summer Olympics** in Rio de Janeiro, where she won four gold medals and one bronze medal.
 
• Simone Biles is celebrated for her groundbreaking routines and skills, such as her ability to execute complex moves like the **Biles II on floor exercise**, which is named after her.
 
• Her consistency and dominance in gymnastics earned her the **2025 Laureus World Sportswoman of the Year award**, a prestigious accolade recognizing exceptional achievements in sports.
 
• Biles has also been instrumental in inspiring young athletes globally and has become a symbol of resilience and excellence in sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gymnastics:**

 
 
• **Gymnastics** is a sport that involves physical exercises requiring strength, flexibility, balance, and coordination. It includes disciplines like artistic gymnastics, rhythmic gymnastics, trampoline, and acrobatics.
 
• Artistic gymnastics is the most popular form and features events like vault, uneven bars, balance beam, and floor exercise for women, and pommel horse, rings, vault, parallel bars, horizontal bar, and floor exercise for men.
 
• The sport is governed internationally by the **International Gymnastics Federation (FIG)**, which sets rules and oversees competitions.
 
• Gymnastics has been part of the **Olympic Games** since its inception in **1896**, and it continues to be a cornerstone event at the Games.
 
• Notable gymnasts apart from Simone Biles include **Nadia Comaneci**, who achieved the first perfect score at the Olympics, and **Larisa Latynina**, who holds the record for the most Olympic medals in gymnastics.
 
 
 
• **Laureus World Sports Awards:**
 
 
• The **Laureus World Sports Awards** are annual awards honoring outstanding sports achievements across various categories. They are often referred to as the "Oscars of sports."
 
• Established in **2000**, the awards recognize athletes, teams, and inspirational moments in sports. Categories include Sportsman of the Year, Sportswoman of the Year, Team of the Year, and Breakthrough of the Year.
 
• Simone Biles has been a frequent nominee and recipient of the Laureus Sportswoman of the Year award due to her consistent brilliance in gymnastics.
 
• The awards are decided by the Laureus World Sports Academy, a jury comprising legendary athletes.
 
• They aim to celebrate sports as a unifying force that transcends cultural and geographical barriers.
 
 
 
• **Simone Biles' Achievements:**
 
 
• Biles has won a total of **32 Olympic and World Championship medals**, making her the most decorated gymnast in history.
 
• She has revolutionized gymnastics by introducing moves that require exceptional skill and athleticism, such as the **Yurchenko double pike vault**.
 
• Her mental health advocacy during the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** brought global attention to the importance of mental well-being in sports.
 
• She has received numerous honors, including being named **Time magazine's 100 Most Influential People** in multiple years.
 
• Simone Biles continues to inspire future generations to pursue excellence both in sports and in life.
 
 
 
• **Other Sports Mentioned in the Options:**
 
 
• **Track and Field:** Focuses on athletic events such as running, jumping, and throwing. Famous athletes include **Usain Bolt** and **Florence Griffith-Joyner**.
 
• **Tennis:** A racquet sport played individually or in doubles. Renowned players include **Roger Federer**, **Serena Williams**, and **Rafael Nadal**.
 
• **Swimming:** A water-based sport with events like freestyle, butterfly, and backstroke. Famous swimmers include **Michael Phelps** and **Katie Ledecky**.
 
• These sports are distinct from gymnastics and require different skill sets and training methods.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Simone Biles** is widely recognized as a role model for perseverance, excellence, and mental health advocacy.
 
• Her contributions to gymnastics have elevated the sport's global profile and inspired countless aspiring athletes.
 
• Understanding the achievements of athletes like Biles helps appreciate the dedication and hard work required in competitive sports.
 
• Gymnastics continues to evolve with new techniques and skills introduced by athletes like Simone Biles.
